Standard: Air vehicle and store mechanical interfaces allow for full range of motion and function of air vehicle and store movable equipment (e.g., guns, shutters, fin deployment, rotary launchers, flaps, slats, speed brakes). Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct digital function checks of air vehicle and store movable equipment to verify operation throughout range of motion. Test.
  (1) Ground test: Verify store mechanical functions IAW MIL-HDBK-1763, Test 101.
  (2) Ground test: Verify ammunition loading, misfire handling, store malfunctions, and gun jams will not cause damage to the air system or injury to crewmembers, IAW MIL-HDBK-1763, Test 160. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (3) Flight test: Verify store mechanical functions operate as intended in the flight environment.
  (4) Flight test: Verify ammunition loading, misfire handling, store malfunctions, and gun jams will not cause damage to the air system or injury to crewmembers, IAW MIL-HDBK-1763, Test 273 and Test 274.
